segments.s1: Ilmi abbaa isaa wajjin deemaa jira.
segments.s3: Haati intala ishee wajjin nyaata bilcheessaa jirti.

walking_with.context: 'is walking' gocha amma raawwatamaa jiru agarsiisa (is + -ing). Ilmi amma abbaa isaa wajjin deemaa jira.
walking_with.example: Isheen hiriyaa ishee wajjin deemaa jirti.

reading_a_book.context: 'is reading' intalli yeroo ammaa kitaaba dubbisaa akka jirtu ibsa.

cooking_food.context: 'is cooking' haati amma intala ishee wajjin nyaata bilcheessaa akka jirtu agarsiisa.
